sources.name: Pro Football Talk
sources.title: Broncos finally make a pick, take Texas A&M DT Tyler Onyedim at No. 66
sources.description: The Broncos didn't pick in the first or second round of the 2026 NFL draft, but they're finally on the board early in the third.
